name: Acme Lamp
description: Power, brightness and status of the Acme Lamp app's local HTTP API.

requires.application: Acme Lamp 2.x with its local API enabled

settings.label: Port
settings.description: Acme Lamp > Settings > Local API > Port.

settings.label: API token
settings.description: Acme Lamp > Settings > Local API > Token. Kept in the macOS Keychain.

setup.title: Turn on the local API
setup.text: In Acme Lamp: Settings > Local API > Enable. Note the port and the token.

setup.title: Enter the port and the token
